results.label: IR receiver
results.message: IR receiver captured nothing during self-loopback.
results.guidance: The emitter works, so the fault is likely the IR receive photodiode. Retry in a dim room away from bright/IR light; if it still captures nothing, the receiver may need service. IR TX works but RX sees nothing. Commonly dust/obstruction over the receive window, or testing in bright IR-heavy light. Clean the window and retry in a dim room before assuming hardware failure.
